This opportunity is part of our 2026 project pipeline, meaning we’re proactively connecting with talented professionals for upcoming roles rather than an immediate opening. Additionally, as part of our hiring process, the first step will be a preliminary technical assessment with an AI-powered recruiter. This helps us ensure an efficient, fair, and consistent experience for all candidates.

This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice which must be identified to the Company. Team members may live in the following locations: Mexico, El Salvador or Colombia.

Your Mission: Enhance the team’s capacity to deliver assigned stories by end of sprint

  • Cultivate Camaraderie: Ensure that Core Values are living and breathing throughout the project team and that these values are reflected within the QA assurance team and department.
  • Increase Velocity: Perform automated testing and API testing for complex applications and scenarios; locate and document edge cases by understanding the depth and intricacies of a project; assess possible risks and propose modifications to the acceptance criteria.
  • Expand Frameworks: Demonstrate proficiency at automation, API testing, or accessibility testing principles and solutions.
  • Increase Velocity: Enhance the team's capacity by documenting plans to anticipated risks/blockers, advancing best practices, and mentoring peers and more junior team members.
  • Guide Development: Serve as a technical SME in the sprint, ensuring successful delivery of the sprint commitment by prioritizing testing efforts, enhancing acceptance criteria, etc.
  • Evaluate Skills: Conduct recruiting interviews and analyze candidates to ensure successful hiring/contracting.
  • Demonstrate Expertise: Present robust testing plans, metrics, and other valuable insight and direction during sprint review meetings; propose solutions and improvements to clients that improve our ability to deliver value.

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Key Activities: Ensuring the team understands acceptance criteria, tracking daily progress, limit team’s QA kickback, deliver stories as assigned, find opportunities to increase capacity and velocity.
  • How a Current Praxenter Describes The Role: “I spend a lot of the sprint planning and delegating technical work for other devs, anticipating how to deliver as much value for the client via efficiency and tech debt prevention. This has the added benefit of allow assigned devs to grow technically while also reducing as many unknowns as possible in the cone of uncertainty. It’s my job to keep in sync with delivery leads on priorities, team allocation, risks, etc, as well as act as the technical interface for the client to help guide them without overloading them with technical jargon.”

Your Qualifications:

  • Technical Proficiency: demonstrable proficiency with desired technologies and tools
    • Deep expertise in developing and maintaining end-to-end test frameworks using Playwright, Cypress, and/or Selenium (TypeScript, JavaScript, Java, Python) for web applications and Appium (Java/Python) for mobile (iOS and Android) testing.
    • Strong proficiency in CI/CD integration of automated tests using tools such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps, including parallel execution, test reporting, and environment management.

  • Practical Experience: 5-8 years professional experience in relevant technology and projects, including ongoing adherence of best practices, leading and executing automated testing for web and mobile applications, and leveraging industry-standard tools to ensure optimal product quality across all stages of the software development lifecycle.
  • Client Leadership: Experience presenting to client stakeholders and communicating technical and business value
  • Outcome Orientation: Experience understanding and articulating the business outcomes that your development projects impact
  • Mentorship Experience: Experience with coaching and mentoring, demonstrated through ad-hoc collaboration and structured code reviews.
  • Relevant Education: may include intensive programs, Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a equivalent experience
  • Values Alignment: We Care Deeply, Always Deliver, Never Settle, Do It Together, Own the Outcome, and approach every situation with a CAN DO mentality – learn more about our Core Values and be sure to let us know which aligns most with your experience!

What You’ll Love About Us:

  • A stable, full-time role. We’ve been building digital products for 25 years. This is a full-time employment opportunity in your country—offering paid time off, local holidays, and country-specific perks.
  • Work/life balance that’s real. We believe work should support your life, not take it over. That’s why we promote a true work/life balance and encourage a 40-hour work week—no more.
  • A culture worth joining. Praxent has been recognized by Best Places to Work in Fintech, Clutch, and Comparably for workplace excellence. Don’t just take our word for it—check out our Glassdoor reviews to hear directly from our team.
  • Support without micromanagement. Your career is yours to grow. We’re here to guide, unblock, and champion you—not hover over your shoulder.
  • Your voice matters. Got an idea? A different perspective? We want to hear it. Our team is built on openness, curiosity, and shared ownership.
  • Time to recharge. You’ll receive paid time off and holidays based on your country’s standards because we believe work-life balance makes better people and better teams.
  • Local perks, global standards. You’ll receive country-specific benefits that reflect where you live—often including bonus pay, local protections, and perks that matter to you. We’ll walk you through all the details when we connect.
  • We invest in your growth. Whether it’s an online course, a tech conference, or a certification you’ve been eyeing—we cover the cost of ongoing learning. We want you to keep growing with us.
  • People-first always. At Praxent, you’re not a number. You’re a person. We lead with kindness, respect, and empathy—because work should feel like a place where you belong.

raw.description:
About Modular Solutions

Founded in 2015, Modular Solutions delivers innovative technology to the insurance industry. Our modular, fully integrated platform enables insurers, mutuals, MGAs and brokers with programs with the ability to manage their entire operations seamlessly through a single software solution. Designed to be affordable and configurable, our platform empowers businesses to innovate, adapt and thrive in an evolving and competitive market.

Position Summary

Modular Solutions is seeking skilled and detail-oriented Product Owners to contribute to the ongoing enhancement of our insurance platform. This posting will be used to fill multiple Product Owner opportunities, with each successful candidate aligned to a specific product stream based on experience, business priorities, and team needs. Product ownership areas may include finance, platform migrations, underwriting and claims, broker stakeholder workflows, including broker portal functionality, email/communications, and related insurance operations capabilities.

The ideal candidates will bring a strong understanding of insurance operations and agile product delivery, with the ability to translate complex business processes into clear, actionable requirements. Whether focused on financial workflows, customer and broker-facing experiences, migration readiness, or underwriting and claims capabilities, you will play a key role in bridging the gap between stakeholders and development teams to ensure business needs are clearly defined, prioritized, and delivered effectively.

We are an AI-enabled team and use AI tools to support product configuration, documentation, research, and workflow efficiency. You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you should be comfortable using AI tools responsibly and applying sound judgment when reviewing and validating outputs.

Key Responsibilities

Core Product Ownership Responsibilities

  • Act as a subject matter expert for assigned product areas, supporting developers, stakeholders, implementation teams, and internal business users.
  • Translate business, customer, and operational needs into clear, actionable product requirements, user stories, workflows, and acceptance criteria.
  • Own and manage the product backlog for assigned product streams, balancing client needs, technical considerations, operational priorities, and strategic product direction.
  • Serve as the bridge between stakeholders and development teams to support the delivery of high-quality, iterative releases.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to define workflows, document configuration logic, clarify business rules, and support scalable product design.
  • Participate in sprint planning, backlog grooming, release planning, and other agile ceremonies to maintain alignment and delivery momentum.
  • Conduct user acceptance testing and support product validation to ensure features meet business requirements, usability expectations, and quality standards.
  • Assist with product demos, training, documentation, and knowledge transfer for internal and external users.
  • Analyze user feedback, stakeholder input, product performance, and operational impacts to inform future product iterations.
  • Communicate progress, risks, decisions, and dependencies clearly and proactively to team members, project leads, and stakeholders.
  • Champion continuous improvement across product processes, collaboration models, documentation practices, and delivery workflows.
  • Use internal technology systems and AI-enabled tools responsibly to support product configuration, documentation, research, workflow analysis, and productivity.
  • Other duties as required and requested by Modular Solutions Inc.

Assigned Product Stream Responsibilities

  • Each Product Owner will be aligned to one or more product streams based on experience, business priorities, and team needs. Responsibilities may include ownership of product capabilities related to finance, broker management, stakeholder workflows, worklists, broker portal functionality, email and communications, or other related platform areas.
  • Depending on the assigned stream, responsibilities may include defining requirements for financial workflows, billing, payments, reconciliation, reporting, broker-facing experiences, workflows, task and queue management, communication workflows, system-generated emails, integrations, or related platform functionality.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in the insurance industry, ideally in roles such as an accounting or finance team member utilizing a policy administration system for accounts receivable and payable generation, reconciliation and reporting, or as a business development team member managing communications with broker stakeholders.
  • Strong knowledge of insurance operations and workflows, including broker, underwriter, and policy administration processes.
  • Ability to model/document requirements, user flows, use cases, and configuration logic.
  • Solid technical understanding of systems architecture, data flows, APIs, and application logic.
  • Familiarity with policy administration systems, insurance SaaS platforms, or other configurable technology solutions.
  • Proficient in tools such as Azure DevOps, Jira, and Miro, or other platforms used for backlog management and sprint planning in agile environments.
  • Experience facilitating user acceptance testing (UAT) and supporting product validation activities.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to bridge technical and business perspectives.
  • Strong critical thinking and analytical skills, especially when evaluating complex rating logic or insurance documentation.
  • Detail-oriented with a high standard for quality, accuracy, and release readiness.
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote, cross-functional team environment.

raw.description:
Founded in 1977 as the Senior Care Action Network, SCAN began with a simple but radical idea: that older adults deserve to stay healthy and independent. That belief was championed by a group of community activists we still honor today as the “12 Angry Seniors.” Their mission continues to guide everything we do.

Today, SCAN is a nonprofit health organization serving more than 500,000 people across Arizona, California, Nevada, New Mexico, Texas, and Washington, with over $8 billion in annual revenue. With nearly five decades of experience, we have built a distinctive, values-driven platform dedicated to improving care for older adults.

Our work spans Medicare Advantage, fully integrated care models, primary care, care for the most medically and socially complex populations, and next-generation care delivery models. Across all of this, we are united by a shared commitment: combining compassion with discipline, innovation with stewardship, and growth with integrity.

At SCAN, we believe scale should strengthen—not dilute—our mission. We are building the future of care for older adults, grounded in purpose, accountability, and respect for the people and communities we serve.

The Job

The Senior Quality Analyst is a key contributor to the Medicare Advantage STAR Program, responsible for analyzing performance data, supporting quality improvement initiatives, managing measure-level interventions, interpretations, and ensuring the organization meets CMS STAR rating goals. This role provides advanced analytical expertise, cross-functional collaboration, and operational support to drive improvements in clinical quality, customer experience, pharmacy measures, and operational compliance. The Analyst must stay current on CMS rules, technical specifications, and methodological changes
related to STAR Ratings, HEDIS, CAHPS, and Medicare Advantage.

You Will

  • Monitor, analyze, and develop insights on STAR measure performance for HEDIS, CAHPS, HOS, Pharmacy (PQA), and Operational measures.

  • Perform root-cause analysis to identify drivers of performance gaps and recommend targeted interventions.

  • Partner with Health Care Informatics and other internal analytics team to ensure dashboards, scorecards, and routine performance reports for leadership and operational partners.

  • Model future projections and perform “What-if” scenarios for STAR rating forecasts.

  • Conduct routine process analysis for department’s operating procedures and validate compliance with regulatory requirements or develop details assessment outlining gaps/risks identified with proposed process redesigns to mitigate identified gaps and risks.

  • Collaborate with internal teams (Clinical Operations, Pharmacy, Member Experience, Network, Provider Relations) to design and implement quality improvement strategies.

  • Track performance of interventions and provide data-driven insights on progress and effectiveness.

  • Conduct Star competitor analysis and develop insights for all SCAN markets, potential partnerships, or growth opportunities.

  • Work with IT and data teams to enhance data infrastructure and ensure data quality for STAR reports, and troubleshoot data discrepancies.

  • Support the design and evaluation of interventions aimed at improving provider performance, member satisfaction, and clinical outcomes.

  • We seek Rebels who are curious about AI and its power to transform how we operate and serve our members.

  • Actively support the achievement of SCAN’s Vision and Goals.

  • Other duties as assigned.

Your Qualifications

  • Experience as a Senior Quality Analyst within a health plan or healthcare organization working with a STAR program is highly desirable.

  • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience required.

  • Master’s degree in a related field preferred.

  • Experience working within a health plan STAR team.

  • Familiarity with claims, encounter, and EMR data.

  • Experience supporting provider engagement or quality improvement initiatives.

  • Strong knowledge of CMS STAR Ratings methodology, HEDIS measures, CAHPS, HOS, and Medicare Advantage quality programs.

  • Advanced proficiency in data analysis tools (Excel, SQL, Python, SAS, R, Tableau, or Power BI).

  • Proficient with MS Office (Access, Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and e-mail.

  • Ability to communicate complex analytical information to diverse audiences.

  • Analytical Thinking and Problem-Solving - excel in breaking down complex information and deriving actionable insights.

  • Strong organizational and project management skills.

  • Ability to work independently and in a team environment. Strong team player.

  • Ability to work under tight deadlines & manage multiple responsibilities independently.

What's in it for you?

  • Base salary range: $71,700 to $103,732 per year

  • Internal title: STARS Quality Analyst Sr

  • Work Mode: Mostly Remote

  • An annual employee bonus program

  • Robust Wellness Program

  • Generous paid-time-off (PTO)

  • 11 paid holidays per year, plus 1 floating holiday, plus 1 birthday holiday

  • Excellent 401(k) Retirement Saving Plan with employer match and contribution

  • Robust employee recognition program

  • Tuition reimbursement

  • An opportunity to become part of a team that makes a difference to our members and our community every day!

We're always looking for talented people to join our team! Qualified applicants are encouraged to apply now!

We are committed to creating a workforce that reflects our community through inclusive programs and initiatives such as equal pay, employee resource groups, inclusive benefits, and more.

raw.description:
Maisha Meds is hiring! We're looking for a VP of Impact Strategy & Partnerships with a background in organizational strategy, business development, research, and delivery to share our next phase of growth and impact.

About Maisha Meds

Maisha Meds is an organization dedicated to improving health care in Africa through best-in-class technology.

Founded in 2017, Maisha Meds has created the largest digital network of private pharmacies and clinics across Kenya, Tanzania, Uganda, and Nigeria through our mobile software. Our platform not only helps these providers improve business by making sales, managing inventory, and tracking patients. It also reimburses them for providing high-quality care for malaria, eyeglasses, and HIV care at discounted costs.

Maisha Meds supports more than 30 million patient visits every year and has provided more than 1.5 million quality-assured reimbursements to-date. We harness data from our network of pharmacies and clinics to reveal health and market trends, which allows us to design better solutions that work for the people we serve. We have worked with leading academic institutions such as UC Berkeley and KEMRI to evaluate the effectiveness of our programs. Research shows that our system is able to significantly increase appropriate malaria case management and the uptake of long-acting contraceptives.

Our work is powered by a diverse group of top-tier global health funders and partners. We recently demonstrated the sustainability of our model through a flagship initiative with the Lagos State Government, where the government adopted our platform for malaria and fever care via a World Bank loan and subsequently direct state budgetary support. Support from our current and future partners will allow us to expand our digital network and deliver high-quality sustainable healthcare to millions of patients. And we continue to demonstrate the impact of 4-7x improvement in quality and effective healthcare via randomized trials and ongoing program data.

About the role

We are seeking a VP, Impact Strategy & Partnerships to lead business development, research partnerships, and oversight of our impact-focused programs. This is a senior, externally-oriented role responsible for growing our portfolio of health programs and funder relationships, from identifying opportunities and building the investment case, to managing awards and ensuring successful delivery.

The VP will work closely with our leadership to shape how we position ourselves with a new generation of global health funders who bring rigorous, evidence-driven standards to their giving. This role requires someone who is intellectually sharp, deeply comfortable with quantitative investment cases, and highly effective at building trust with sophisticated, values-aligned donors. This work will also support our ongoing efforts to raise a significant results-linked health access fund, called Healthy Futures.

This role is remote-first with frequent travel for fundraising and to our countries of operation. You will report to our Chief Development Officer (CDO) and supervise a team with a focus on business development and program design & delivery.

The start date is Sept 1, and compensation is commensurate with experience.

Responsibilities

Business development, pipeline, & relationship management

  • Oversee team that leads end-to-end business development across our health program portfolio, including vision, TB, AI, HIV, malaria, and new areas; with a focus on scaling Maisha Meds’ proven approach to results-based financing, including via the current results-linked health access fund.
  • Build and manage a pipeline of family offices, Effective Altruism-aligned funders, and high-net-worth philanthropists, with a focus on donors who prioritize evidence, cost-effectiveness, and scalable impact.
  • Represent the organization externally at relevant convenings and lead external communications related to impact strategy.

Strategy review, evidence development, & model iteration

  • Lead strategy development across impact areas of Maisha Meds, with a focus on patient programs and LLMs, including prioritization of existing and new health areas.

raw.description:
Job Description:

About Nextpower

Founded in 2013, Nextpower operates as an independent subsidiary of Flex, a leading Sketch-to-Scale™ solutions company that designs and builds intelligent products for a connected world. Delivering smart PV and storage solutions on close to 400 solar power plants across five continents, with nine global offices, Nextpower is an established leader in the ground mount solar and storage industries. Having earned the #1 market share leadership position for solar trackers world-wide for two consecutive years (Greentech Media, IHS Markit, 2016 & 2017), Nextpower is recognized as one of the Top Workplaces for 2023 by the San Francisco Chronicle.

Position Overview

Nextpower is looking for a Sr Structural Engineer to join the Europe Project Engineering Team based in Italy (remote position). Working directly with key accounts located throughout Europe to manage day to day issues on utility scale PV projects from the development stage to construction support.

This key leadership role will manage all decisions relating to Structural Engineering for Nextpower’s projects including but not limited to wind load calculations, steel design and component sizing, foundation sizing, and various other structural engineering tasks and decisions to support project quoting and calculation packages. Further, this position will be responsible for guiding structural aspects of utility-scale PV projects across global markets, collaborating and interfacing with the rest of the engineering team located in the US, Mexico, Brazil, Australia, and India as well as Sales, Project Management, and R&D teams at Nextpower’s offices around the world. The role also involves leading and mentoring engineering talent within the team to ensure high technical standards, professional development, and workload balance.

Responsibilities

  • Produce civil and structural design documentation, including drawings and calculations.

  • Act as the signing engineer for structural engineering projects in Italy, certifying calculations, and technical reports according to national regulations.

  • Manage all administrative and technical engineering documentation workflows with local authorities, specifically handling submission, approval processes, and compliance tracking with the Genio Civile.

  • Lead and mentor team members, ensuring high technical standards, professional development, and workload balance.

  • Assist in the project development phase, review pertinent site information, calculations, and cost estimation.

  • Prepare wind, seismic, foundation, and other structural calculations.

  • Provide construction support, manage RFIs, submittals, and technical calculation packages.

  • Assist in development of Nextpower products and generate a full understanding of the Nextpower product catalog.

  • Coordinate with Nextpower's Structural/Civil/Geotechnical Engineers in other regions to create, maintain, and update structural and civil standards, specifications, templates, and design tools.

  • Manage schedules and review structural and civil engineering external consultants' works and deliverables to ensure alignment with project timelines and technical requirements.

  • Assist in development of expanding Nextpower Design Services team.

  • Oversee the development of new structural sections and integration into standard Nextpower systems.

  • Represent Nextpower in technical forums: author white papers, present at conferences, and maintain knowledge of current trends and advancements.

Required Skills / Experiences

  • Education: BS or Master's degree in Structural or Civil Engineering or equivalent.

  • Professional Certification (Mandatory): Must be a chartered/licensed professional engineer in Italy (Abilitazione all'esercizio della professione / Iscrizione all'Ordine degli Ingegneri) with full legal authority to sign off on structural projects (firma dei progetti).

  • Regulatory Expertise (Mandatory): Proven track record and direct experience in structural document management and file processing with the Genio Civile. Deep understanding of Italian structural construction codes (NTC) and regional authorization procedures.

  • Software Proficiency: Proficiency in MS Office, AutoCAD, LPile, and other structural analysis software (RISA, STAAD, or equivalent).

  • Standards & Codes: Thorough knowledge of engineering standards and codes including but not limited to: Italian NTC, Eurocodes, ASCE, AISC, AISI, and IBC.

  • Technical Expertise: Significant work experience in structural analysis and design, including dead, live, snow, wind, and seismic loads, design of steel and concrete structures, and development of construction documents.

  • Soft Skills: Excellent communication and organizational skills; ability to lead in a cross-functional, multicultural environment.

  • Languages: Proficient in English and Italian. Spanish is a plus.

  • Travel: Willingness to travel occasionally for site investigations, field support, or meetings with local authorities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Programming skills in VB and Python is a plus.

  • Specific background in solar tracker foundation and structural design and optimization.

  • Familiarity with corrosion mechanisms, soil corrosion data, and mitigation techniques.

  • Previous experience in a matrixed, global organization.

Applications and customers range from behind the meter solar farms with Fortune 500 companies like PepsiCo and L’Oreal to massive utility-scale power plants across domestic and international markets, and a portfolio of energy storage solutions. Join a market leader that values our talent, service excellence and innovation as core to our business growth and culture. At Nextpower, we are driving the global energy transition with an integrated clean energy technology platform that combines intelligent structural, electrical, and digital solutions for utility-scale power plants. Our comprehensive portfolio enables faster project delivery, higher performance, and greater reliability, helping our customers capture the full value of solar power. Our talented worldwide teams are redefining how solar power plants are designed, built, and operated every day with smart technology, data-driven insights, and advanced automation. Ontario Lead

The Transition Accelerator

Le français suit.

This position is fully remote but requires the selected applicant to reside in Ontario and be able to attend in-person events in the province.

Overview

The Transition Accelerator drives projects, partnerships, and strategies to ensure Canada is competitive in a carbon-neutral world. We're harnessing the global shift towards clean growth to secure permanent jobs, abundant energy, and strong regional economies across the country. We work with 300+ partner organizations to build out pathways to a prosperous low-carbon economy and avoid costly dead-ends along the way. By connecting systems-level thinking with real-world analysis, we're enabling a more affordable, competitive, and resilient future for all Canadians.

Are you ready to roll up your sleeves and make a real impact? We are looking for a dynamic, action-oriented individual who is passionate about creating positive change and ready to tackle some of the toughest economic and environmental challenges facing our nation and the world. Join our team, where your ideas will drive real-world solutions, your leadership will shape the future, and your efforts will directly contribute to a better, more sustainable world.

As part of our innovative, forward-thinking organization, you will work alongside technical, strategy and knowledge mobilization leaders, you will collaborate on high-impact projects and initiatives and be at the forefront of making sure Canada stays one of the best places in the world to live. This is more than just a job—it is an opportunity to be part of something bigger and make a lasting difference. Ready to step up? We would like to hear from you.

About the Role

Reporting to the Director of Regional & Sectoral Pathways, the Ontario Lead will drive the development and implementation of strategies aimed at reducing emissions and bolstering economic development in Ontario, while ensuring provincial insights meaningfully inform national initiatives. The role focuses on identifying strategic priorities, gaps, and intervention points in Ontario’s low-carbon transition, and working with industry, governments, and other partners to translate those priorities into coordinated action. By leveraging Ontario’s strengths in clean energy, industry, and innovation, the Ontario Lead will support decision-makers with clear strategies that align climate ambition with economic opportunity.

Duties and Responsibilities

Strategic Development & Positioning

  • Lead the development and execution of a focused Transition Accelerator strategy for Ontario, including setting priorities, sequencing interventions, and identifying critical gaps in the low-carbon landscape.
  • Determine where the Transition Accelerator can provide the greatest strategic value to Ontario stakeholders, including utilities, provincial government, industry, municipalities, and Indigenous partners.
  • Design strategic intervention points and partnerships that leverage TA’s expertise to accelerate Ontario’s transition to a competitive, carbon-neutral economy.

Regional Leadership & Strategy

  • Provide ongoing strategic leadership on Ontario’s transition by maintaining a clear, credible perspective on the province’s economic, energy, and industrial context.
  • Identify and advance opportunities that strengthen Ontario’s competitiveness in the low-carbon transition, with particular attention to the province’s energy system and industrial strengths.
  • Ensure Ontario priorities, constraints, and opportunities are clearly articulated within the Accelerator’s broader regional and national strategy.

Project Execution & Management

  • Lead the development and delivery of an Ontario Regional Decision-Support tool that clarifies transition pathways and economic opportunities associated with Ontario’s path to carbon neutrality.
  • Oversee project execution to ensure analytical outputs are timely, decision-relevant, and aligned with stakeholder needs.

Stakeholder Engagement

  • Lead engagement with Ontario stakeholders to build alignment around strategic priorities, transition pathways, and implementation opportunities.
  • Work closely with the Public Affairs team to develop and deliver Ontario-specific communication and engagement strategies.
  • Present analysis, findings, and recommendations to senior decision-makers in government, industry, and related institutions, and facilitate collaboration between provincial and national initiatives.

Other Duties

  • Contribute to broader regional & sectoral pathways initiatives intended to advance the Accelerator’s mission with diverse stakeholder groups and platforms supporting our work across Canada.
  • Contribute expertise and support to organizational vertical priorities, including electricity, low-carbon fuels, building decarbonization, and future economy.

Required experience

  • 7-10 years of professional experience in energy policy, stakeholder management, industry, public policy, technology analysis, finance or related sector.
  • Excellent understanding of the Ontario political landscape and established relationships with industrial sectors and government.
  • Bachelor’s degree in economics, political science, engineering, or a related field.
  • Strong ability to write, analyze, and brief convincingly.
  • Strong project management skills, with ability to handle multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Ability to balance a quick-paced work environment with attention to detail and quality controls.

Assets

  • Bilingualism is an asset.
  • Comfort using technological tools to boost productivity and efficiency.

Location and Travel

This is a full-time remote role in Ontario. The successful applicant is expected to provide their own place of work and to be available during core hours between 9 a.m. and 5 p.m., Monday to Friday, in their local time zone.

The Transition Accelerator is an equal opportunity employer and recruits, employs, trains, compensates, and promotes regardless of race, religion, colour, age, sex, national origin, disability, and other protected status as required by applicable law.

This position has an attractive compensation package benchmarked to private sector standards.

The competition will remain open until the position is filled. Only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

---

Responsable de l’Ontario

L’Accélérateur de transition


Rôle hybride pour les personnes candidates à Montréal ou à Calgary, entièrement à distance ailleurs au Canada

Vue d’ensemble

L’Accélérateur de transition mène des projets, des partenariats et des stratégies pour que le Canada demeure concurrentiel dans un monde carboneutre. Nous misons sur l’élan mondial vers la croissance propre afin d’assurer des emplois durables, une énergie abondante et des économies régionales solides à l’échelle du pays. Nous collaborons avec plus de 300 organisations partenaires pour tracer des voies vers une économie prospère et sobre en carbone, tout en évitant les impasses coûteuses en cours de route. En reliant une pensée systémique à des analyses concrètes, nous favorisons un avenir plus abordable, plus concurrentiel et plus résilient pour l’ensemble de la population canadienne.

Prêt·e à retrousser vos manches et à avoir un réel impact? Nous cherchons une personne dynamique, portée à l’action, passionnée par le changement positif et prête à s’attaquer à certains des défis économiques et environnementaux les plus complexes auxquels font face notre pays et le monde. Joignez-vous à notre équipe, où vos idées alimenteront des solutions concrètes, votre leadership façonnera l’avenir et vos efforts contribueront directement à un monde meilleur et plus durable.

Au sein de notre organisation innovante et tournée vers l’avenir, vous travaillerez aux côtés de spécialistes techniques, de la stratégie et de la mobilisation des connaissances; vous collaborerez à des projets et des initiatives à fort impact et serez à l’avant-plan pour que le Canada demeure l’un des meilleurs endroits où vivre. Plus qu’un emploi — c’est l’occasion de faire partie de quelque chose de plus grand et de laisser une trace durable. Prêt·e à relever le défi? Nous voulons faire votre connaissance.

À propos du poste

Relevant du directeur des trajectoires régionales et sectorielles, le ou la responsable de l’Ontario sera chargé·e de piloter l’élaboration et la mise en œuvre de stratégies visant à réduire les émissions tout en renforçant le développement économique de l’Ontario, en veillant également à ce que les perspectives provinciales alimentent de façon significative les initiatives nationales. Le poste consiste à identifier les priorités stratégiques, les lacunes et les points d’intervention clés de la transition ontarienne vers une économie sobre en carbone, et à travailler avec l’industrie, les gouvernements et d’autres partenaires afin de traduire ces priorités en actions coordonnées. En s’appuyant sur les atouts de l’Ontario en matière d’énergie propre, d’industrie et d’innovation, le ou la responsable de l’Ontario appuiera les décideurs grâce à des stratégies claires qui concilient ambition climatique et opportunités économiques.

Fonctions et responsabilités

Développement stratégique et positionnement

  • Piloter l’élaboration et la mise en œuvre d’une stratégie ciblée de l’Accélérateur de transition pour l’Ontario, incluant l’établissement des priorités, la séquence des interventions et l’identification des lacunes critiques dans l’écosystème de transition vers une économie sobre en carbone.
  • Déterminer où l’Accélérateur de transition peut offrir la plus grande valeur stratégique aux parties prenantes ontariennes, notamment les services publics, le gouvernement provincial, l’industrie, les municipalités et les partenaires autochtones.
  • Concevoir des points d’intervention stratégiques et des partenariats qui tirent parti de l’expertise de l’Accélérateur afin d’accélérer la transition de l’Ontario vers une économie carboneutre et concurrentielle.

Leadership régional et stratégie

  • Assurer un leadership stratégique continu sur la transition de l’Ontario en maintenant une compréhension claire et crédible du contexte économique, énergétique et industriel de la province.
  • Identifier et faire progresser des occasions qui renforcent la compétitivité de l’Ontario dans la transition vers une économie à faibles émissions, en mettant particulièrement l’accent sur le système énergétique et les forces industrielles de la province.
  • Veiller à ce que les priorités, contraintes et occasions propres à l’Ontario soient clairement intégrées à la stratégie régionale et nationale globale de l’Accélérateur de transition.

Exécution de projets et gestion

  • Diriger le développement et la mise en œuvre d’un outil ontarien d’aide à la décision qui clarifie les trajectoires de transition et les opportunités économiques associées à la trajectoire de l’Ontario vers la carboneutralité.
  • Superviser l’exécution des projets afin de s’assurer que les livrables analytiques sont produits en temps opportun, qu’ils répondent aux besoins des décideurs et qu’ils sont alignés sur les attentes des parties prenantes.

Mobilisation des parties prenantes

  • Diriger la mobilisation des parties prenantes ontariennes afin de favoriser l’alignement autour des priorités stratégiques, des trajectoires de transition et des occasions de mise en œuvre.
  • Travailler en étroite collaboration avec l’équipe des affaires publiques pour élaborer et déployer des stratégies de communication et de mobilisation propres à l’Ontario.
  • Présenter les analyses, constats et recommandations aux décideurs de haut niveau des gouvernements, de l’industrie et d’organisations connexes, et faciliter la collaboration entre les initiatives provinciales et nationales.

Autres responsabilités

  • Contribuer à des initiatives plus larges de trajectoires régionales et sectorielles visant à faire progresser la mission de l’Accélérateur de transition auprès de divers groupes de parties prenantes et plateformes appuyant notre travail à l’échelle du Canada.
  • Mettre à profit son expertise et appuyer les priorités verticales de l’organisation, notamment en matière d’électricité, de carburants à faibles émissions, de décarbonation des bâtiments et d’économie de demain.

Expérience requise

  • De 7 à 10 années d’expérience professionnelle en politiques énergétiques, gestion des parties prenantes, industrie, politiques publiques, analyse technologique, finance ou dans un domaine connexe.
  • Excellente connaissance du contexte politique ontarien et relations établies avec les secteurs industriels et les instances gouvernementales.
  • Baccalauréat en économie, en science politique, en génie ou dans un domaine connexe.
  • Excellentes capacités de rédaction, d’analyse et de préparation de notes d’information claires et convaincantes.
  • Solides compétences en gestion de projets, avec la capacité de gérer plusieurs priorités et échéanciers simultanément.

Staff Backend Engineer – Rust / Ruby

Remote · Full-time

About Ubiminds

Ubiminds is a GPTW-certified, people-first company that partners with American software product companies to scale their development teams. We connect Brazil’s top 5% talent with innovative U.S. companies through a unique combination of staff augmentation and employer-of-record services.

We are supporting a U.S.-based healthcare technology company that is building and expanding a healthcare data platform and member management solution used by health insurance carriers and technology partners.

Challenge

We’re looking for a Staff Backend Engineer who combines deep technical expertise with strong ownership and leadership skills.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys tackling complex and unstructured problems, designing scalable backend systems, and influencing both technical direction and engineering culture. You'll help build the next generation of healthcare infrastructure while contributing to AI-powered initiatives and mentoring other engineers.

As a senior technical contributor, you'll have significant autonomy and the opportunity to shape architecture, engineering standards, and product evolution.

What You'll Do

  • Build and expand a large-scale healthcare data platform and member management solution.

  • Design, develop, and maintain high-performance backend services and APIs.

  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering teams to deliver scalable solutions.

  • Take ownership of projects from concept through deployment and ongoing operation.

  • Contribute to AI-powered initiatives and help design and launch AI-driven products and features.

  • Scale infrastructure that connects healthcare insurance carriers and technology partners.

  • Improve engineering standards, development practices, and technical processes.

  • Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through technical guidance and code reviews.

  • Participate in architecture discussions and long-term technical planning.

  • Write clean, maintainable, well-tested, and production-ready code.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience.

  • Strong hands-on experience with Rust in production environments.

  • Experience designing, building, and maintaining APIs.

  • Proven experience building and launching AI-powered products or projects.

  • Strong understanding of software architecture and backend system design.

  • Passion for software craftsmanship and high-quality engineering practices.

  • Ability to take ownership of complex, unstructured problems and drive solutions independently.

  • Experience working in highly collaborative engineering teams.

  • Strong communication skills with an emphasis on transparency and positive collaboration.

  • English proficiency at C1 (written and verbal).

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with Ruby and Ruby-based applications.

  • Experience with:

    • Docker

    • Kubernetes

    • Helm

    • Terraform

  • Exposure to observability and monitoring platforms such as Datadog.

  • Experience with performance monitoring and optimization.

  • Experience handling production incidents and improving operational excellence.

  • Knowledge of CI/CD optimization and deployment automation.

  • Background in large-scale distributed systems or infrastructure-intensive products.

  • Experience working within healthcare, insurance, or highly regulated industries.

Team & Environment

  • Highly collaborative engineering culture with strong ownership and autonomy.

  • Opportunity to influence technical direction and engineering standards.

  • Focus on innovation, scalability, and AI-driven solutions.

  • Modern cloud-native environment supporting large-scale healthcare technology platforms.

  • Strong emphasis on mentorship, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement.

Why Join

  • Work on meaningful healthcare technology that impacts millions of users.

  • Help shape the future of AI-powered healthcare solutions.

  • Influence architecture, engineering culture, and technical strategy.

  • Collaborate with highly skilled international engineering teams.

  • Full support from Ubiminds, including career guidance, HR, and administrative services.

  • Remote-first culture with opportunities for professional growth and global exposure.

About Ubiminds
Our Culture
- People First. We are all about people!
- Challenge yourself. There’s always room for improvement and continuous improvement is in our essence.
- Make it happen. Be ready to take challenges as they come. It’s all about attitude and commitment.
- We’re in this together. We work as a team, thrive as a team, and evolve as a team.
- Averaging on awesome. We work hard to deliver high-quality services and look forward to exceeding expectations.
- Keep it real. We promise you honesty, transparency, and openness, regardless of the situation.

Perks and Benefits

As Staff Backend Engineer @Ubiminds, you:
- You are placed in a product-based company, with the same treatment as their full-time employees.
- Have our full back-office support, from career guidance to HR and concierge services.
- Enjoy our remote-first policy – we are a distributed team, after all.
- Get your own MacBook (none of that "bring your own device" stuff here).
- Have access to growth opportunities with other amazing technology professionals, through tech talks, chapter meetings, and even remote happy hours for tons of fun!
- Improve your English through free lessons with a native English speaker - get to the next level on your communication skills!
- Candidate Referral bonus (promote Ubi to your tech friends, and get paid for it!)
- Miss working in the office? Our cool Florianópolis headquarters is available, whenever you want, with weekly quick massages & tasty snacks, soft drinks, and games
How our process works
1. Interview with Tech Recruiter (chat about the job opening and your experiences)
2. Technical Assessment

4. Offer (yay)

Reporting to the Director of Government Programs Performance & Strategy, this role supports the advancement of Government Programs performance and priorities across Medicare and DSNP lines of business. Assess current state of marketplace trends, competitive activities, and Government Programs performance to identify gaps in corporate and divisional plans. Develop mitigation strategies to ensure achievement of corporate and divisional goals. Serve as a strategic thought partner, synthesizing cross-functional data and inputs into insights and decision-ready narratives for leadership. Assess existing organization project portfolio; ensure projects add value to organization and contribute to the achievement of key performance indicators. Assist in the analysis and research for short and long-range corporate and Government Programs strategy development.

What you will do:

  • Assess existing organization project portfolio; ensure projects add value to organization and contribute to achieving key performance indicators.

  • Collaborate with Government Programs leaders and enterprise partners to ensure initiatives achieve expected business results.

  • Mentor less experienced staff.

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What you need to succeed:

  • Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education and applicable work experience

  • Three to five+ years of experience in business analysis, market research, or a strategic planning capacity

  • Experience developing executive-level and associate-level presentations and translating complex inputs into clear narratives

  • Knowledge of strategic planning frameworks, processes, best practices, and how to support the development and advancement of a strategic plan

  • Ability to quickly learn new subject matter, ask the right questions, and independently build working knowledge of complex business areas

  • Knowledge of business analysis industry trends and best-practices

  • Knowledge of market research methodologies

  • Strong research capabilities

  • Advanced analytical skills, with the ability to interpret and synthesize complex data sets

  • Attention to detail

  • Good business acumen and political savvy

  • Knowledge of business process improvement techniques and strategies

  • Excellent verbal and written communications skills

  • Presentation development skills

  • Decision-making skills

  • Creative and resourceful problem-solving skills

  • Ability to interface with employees at all levels

  • Comfort in a dynamic and fast-moving work environment

  • Ability to effectively navigate ambiguous situations with limited direction

  • Excellent organizational skills and ability to successfully prioritize multiple tasks

  • Ability to handle multiple priorities/projects, establish workflows, and meet necessary deadlines

The extras:

  • Experience designing executive-ready reports and dashboards (e.g., Power BI or similar tools).

  • Experience leveraging Microsoft Copilot or other AI-assisted analytics and productivity tools.

  • Background in health insurance, Medicare Advantage, or regulated healthcare environments

  • Familiarity with Medicare/managed care, CMS, Star Ratings, or risk adjustment preferred

Summary

At CCT, we build software that changes how casinos operate. More than 350 properties worldwide run on our Casino Insight platform, trading manual processes for intelligent automation and turning mountains of data into clarity. We're evolving that platform, and the product thinking behind Insight Cash is where you come in.

As Product Manager for Insight Cash, you'll own the strategy, roadmap, and day-to-day execution of our core cage management and cash operations software, used by cage, vault, audit, and accounting teams across our entire client portfolio.

This role is built for someone who has been a product manager in a startup or early-growth-stage environment. You've worn many hats, built process from scratch, and driven outcomes without waiting for perfect infrastructure. You move easily between strategy and hands-on execution. We're also building AI into how we work and what we ship, and you'll engage with that effort directly, whether through prior experience or the drive to develop that fluency quickly.

What You'll Do

  • Own the Insight Cash roadmap, balancing customer commitments, platform migration, and longer-term strategic investments
  • Maintain a clear prioritization framework and surface tradeoffs so stakeholders understand how decisions get made
  • Translate business goals and customer needs into a product vision the team can rally around
  • Lead ongoing discovery through customer conversations, interviews, field visits, and feedback from Client Solutions and Support
  • Become the internal authority on casino cage and cash operations workflows
  • Partner with Engineering and QA to define, refine, and deliver features, writing clear requirements and maintaining a healthy backlog
  • Drive release planning across Product, Engineering, QA, and Client Solutions
  • Evaluate where AI capabilities can create real value in Insight Cash, and champion AI tooling across the development lifecycle

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • 4 to 7 years of product management, including meaningful time at a startup or early-growth-stage company with broad scope and high ownership
  • A track record of owning a product end to end, from discovery through delivery and go-to-market
  • Strong discovery and research skills: interviews, synthesis, and translating insight into prioritized decisions
  • Close partnership with engineering teams, writing crisp requirements and navigating tradeoffs with clarity and respect
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, from requirements to customer-facing release notes
  • Self-directed and comfortable with ambiguity
  • A genuine orientation toward AI as both a product capability and a way of working

    • Nice to have:

  • Building or scaling a PM function in an early-stage environment
  • Responsible AI practices (accuracy, auditability, trust) in regulated settings
  • B2B SaaS in operational or back-office workflows
  • Supporting a desktop-to-web migration
  • Background in, or curiosity about, the gaming and casino industry

About CCT

CCT is the creator of Casino Insight™, the award-winning platform trusted by more than 350 casinos worldwide to automate cage operations, revenue audits, and operational analysis. Since 2012, Casino Insight has helped casinos replace manual work with streamlined workflows, improving accuracy, compliance, and profitability.

Headquartered in Tulsa, Oklahoma, CCT integrates seamlessly with leading casino management, hospitality, and financial systems—delivering measurable ROI and empowering teams to work smarter at every level.

  • Work closely with the various sales, marketing, and technical teams to share market feedback and support your sales activities,
  • Collaborate with Customer Success on customer onboarding customer accounts to ensure customer satisfaction and to identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities,

  • We’re growing rapidly, and our global customer base includes Government, large global enterprises, and some of the worlds’ most exciting tech companies,

About the Role

ServiceCore builds the software that runs the portable sanitation and liquid waste industry — a niche most people have never thought about but that keeps job sites, events, and communities operational. Our customers rely on us daily, and the Senior Software Engineer owns the technical quality of what we ship: designing systems, guiding architectural decisions, and driving down the technical debt that would otherwise slow us down.

You’ll work as the technical anchor of a small, cross-functional pod of 2–3 engineers, partnering closely with Product and Design. You’ll mentor SE1s and SE2s, participate in customer discovery to keep your work grounded in real problems, and hold the line on quality through thoughtful code review and a strong testing strategy.

Our stack is Angular & Typescript (frontend), PHP/Laminas Framework (API), MySQL, AWS, and Ionic ( for mobile. We work fully remote, come together once a year as a company, and do quarterly planning as a team. If you’re near Denver, CO, a hybrid option is available.

What You'll Do

  • Architect features and systems end-to-end — from data model through API through UI — and own the implementation quality across your pod.
  • Define and champion the testing strategy for your team: what to test, how to test it, and how to keep the suite maintainable over time.
  • Identify and address technical debt proactively — propose the tradeoffs clearly, get alignment, and execute.
  • Mentor SE1s and SE2s through code review, pairing, and direct feedback; raise the technical bar of your team without being a bottleneck.
  • Participate in customer discovery with Product to ensure your technical decisions are solving real problems, not imagined ones.
  • Lead AI-assisted development practices on your team — using tools like Cursor, Copilot, and agentic workflows to increase throughput and help your teammates do the same.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with clear ownership of complex, production systems.
  • Strong command of backend development (PHP, Java, or similar object-oriented language) and relational databases (MySQL/MariaDB preferred).
  • Solid frontend experience with a modern framework — Angular preferred, React or Vue considered.
  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools (Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar) as a real part of your workflow, not an experiment.
  • Demonstrable ability to architect systems: you’ve made hard technical decisions, documented them, and stood behind them when questioned.
  • Track record of mentoring more junior engineers and improving the team around you, not just your own output.
  • Comfort operating in a product-led environment — you engage with the ‘why’ behind features, not just the spec.

Bonus points for:

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, field service, or operational software
  • Familiarity with Ionic or mobile development
  • AWS experience (Lambda, RDS, S3, etc.)
  • Experience with agentic AI workflows or building LLM-powered tooling

Who Thrives Here

ServiceCore’s values are: Love Our Customers, Give a Shit, Deliver Results, Be Real, and Keep It Fun. Senior engineers who do well here care about the craft without being precious about it. They’re willing to dig into unglamorous problems because the customer impact is real. They give direct feedback, take ownership without waiting for permission and make the people around them better. If you want to be the smartest person in the room and protect that status, this isn’t the right fit. If you want to do meaningful work, build things that matter, and have a good time doing it — let’s talk.

Work Environment & Benefits

  • For Denver HQ: Tuesdays and Wednesday in office for local employees (free parking!)
  • Casual, collaborative culture with direct access to leadership and an open-office environment
  • Fully remote WFH set up if applicable
  • 14 Company Holidays + Unlimited PTO
  • Healthcare, dental, and vision insurance with generous employer contributions
  • 401K with company match
  • Regular team events and company bashes
  • Weekly lunches and a fully-stocked kitchen (if in Denver)
  • Bi-weekly Grubhub lunch stipend for remote employees

Large‑scale language models are evolving from clever chatbots into powerful engines of scientific discovery and technical problem-solving. With high‑quality training data, tomorrow’s AI can democratize world‑class education, keep pace with cutting‑edge research, and streamline work for engineers, scientists, and analysts everywhere. raw.description:
Striim, (pronounced “stream” with two i’s for integration and intelligence), is a unified data integration and streaming platform that connects clouds, data, and applications with unprecedented speed and simplicity to deliver the right data at the right time. Striim is used by enterprise companies to monitor events across any environment, build applications that drive digital transformation, and leverage true real-time analytics to provide a superior experience to their customers. At our company, we believe and expect all of our employees to operate as one with unlimited potential and dignity.

We are seeking a strategic, technically adept Product Marketing leader to own product marketing across our three core go-to-market motions: Application & Data Modernization, Event Stream Processing, and the Real-Time Contextual Data Platform for Enterprise AI.

This role will translate Striim's real-time data streaming, change data capture (CDC), observability, and AI-agent capabilities—including Sherlock, Sentinel, Euclid, Foreseer, CoPilot, and MCP AgentLink—into compelling market positioning, differentiated messaging, successful product launches, and field-ready sales assets that drive pipeline growth, win rates, and category leadership.

As the senior Product Marketing voice within the organization, this role partners closely with Product Management, Sales, Alliances, Customer Success, and Enablement to transform product innovation into measurable commercial outcomes.

Responsibilities

  • Define and execute global go-to-market strategies for Striim's platform, solutions, and AI-driven innovations across Application & Data Modernization, Event Stream Processing, and Enterprise AI use cases.
  • Develop customer segmentation, positioning, messaging, and value frameworks aligned to key technical and business decision-makers, including CIOs, CDOs, Enterprise Architects, Database Administrators, and Data Engineers.
  • Partner with Product, Sales, and Alliances teams to align product roadmap priorities with market opportunities, customer demand, and revenue objectives.
  • Drive product launches from strategy through execution, including platform releases, AI capabilities, and solution enhancements, while establishing success metrics tied to pipeline generation, adoption, and ARR impact.
  • Translate complex technical capabilities—including CDC, real-time streaming, data integration, AI agents, and observability—into clear, differentiated business value propositions.
  • Create and maintain messaging frameworks that communicate measurable outcomes such as accelerated cloud modernization, reduced total cost of ownership, improved AI readiness, faster time-to-value, and reduced operational risk.
  • Develop and maintain high-impact sales enablement assets, including battlecards, competitive positioning, pitch decks, demo narratives, ROI tools, customer presentations, and executive messaging.
  • Partner directly with Sales, Solutions Engineering, and Alliances teams on strategic enterprise opportunities to improve deal velocity, competitive differentiation, and win rates.
  • Monitor industry trends, competitive developments, emerging technologies, and regulatory changes across financial services, healthcare, retail, manufacturing, telecommunications, and other enterprise markets.
  • Conduct competitive analysis against Oracle GoldenGate, Confluent, Fivetran, custom Kafka architectures, and emerging real-time AI and data platform providers.
  • Deliver actionable market intelligence and customer insights that influence product strategy, roadmap decisions, and go-to-market execution.
  • Represent Striim through analyst briefings, webinars, conferences, customer advisory boards, cloud partner events, and thought leadership initiatives.
  • Serve as the voice of the customer and market within the organization, helping guide future product innovation and strategic investment decisions.
  • Collaborate with executive leadership and technical subject matter experts to develop thought leadership content that advances Striim's market position and category leadership.
  • Leverage modern AI-enabled workflows and tools to accelerate content development, competitive analysis, enablement creation, and go-to-market execution while maintaining high standards of quality and accuracy.

Requirements

  • 8–12 years of experience in B2B software product marketing, with a minimum of 3 years in a Senior Manager, Director, or equivalent leadership role.
  • Proven experience marketing enterprise software solutions within data infrastructure, data integration, data streaming, analytics, cloud platforms, developer tools, AI/ML, or related technology categories.
  • Demonstrated success leading end-to-end product launches that delivered measurable business outcomes, including pipeline growth, revenue impact, customer adoption, or market expansion.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise buying processes and the ability to develop messaging that resonates with both technical and executive stakeholders.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with a demonstrated ability to create messaging, narratives, and sales content that drive action.
  • Experience building sales enablement programs and assets that improve seller effectiveness and support enterprise deal cycles.
  • Familiarity with enterprise sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC, Challenger Sale, or comparable consultative selling frameworks.
  • Experience supporting hyperscaler partner ecosystems, including Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, and Amazon Web Services, through joint go-to-market and co-sell initiatives.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced, high-growth environment while managing multiple priorities and stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated use of AI-enabled productivity tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gong AI, or similar technologies to improve business outcomes and operational efficiency.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Change Data Capture (CDC), real-time data streaming, event-driven architectures, streaming analytics, or the Apache Kafka ecosystem.
  • Knowledge of modern cloud data platforms including Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Spanner, Microsoft Fabric, or comparable technologies.
  • Experience marketing AI-native, AI-assisted, agentic AI, or machine learning-based product portfolios.
  • Previous experience working within a high-growth technology company scaling from approximately $30M to $150M in annual recurring revenue.
  • Experience in analyst relations, including engagements with Gartner, Forrester, IDC, or similar industry analyst organizations.
  • Background spanning Product Marketing, Product Management, Sales Engineering, Solutions Consulting, or direct customer-facing commercial roles.
  • Experience supporting enterprise software sales within highly regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare, telecommunications, or public sector organizations.
  • Familiarity with cloud marketplaces, partner ecosystems, and enterprise software procurement models.
  • Passion for emerging technologies and a strong curiosity about the evolving intersection of real-time data, AI, analytics, and enterprise modernization.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and pre-IPO stock options
  • Comprehensive health care plans (medical, dental and vision), including medical and dependent FSA
  • Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick & Public Holidays)
  • The chance to contribute to and shape an upbeat, fully engaged culture

Compensation

$225,000 - 235,000 USD on an annualized basis. In addition to base pay, this role offers the opportunity to earn variable-based rewards.

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis and accepted until the position is filled.

Our company culture fosters entrepreneurship and nurtures our team members to grow with the company. Come join a Silicon Valley startup focused on delivering a product that’s loved by its customers and primed to be a core part of the cloud data stack.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we value diversity at our company.It is in our best interest to continue to foster an environment of diversity, equity, and inclusion to bring the most value to our workforce, customers, and partners. MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • Demonstrated experience supporting the Federal Government.
  • Current certifications under the Guidelines for Home Energy Professionals (GHEP) framework, specifically Energy Auditor and Quality Control Inspector, or the demonstrated ability to obtain both certifications by September 30, 2026.
  • In-depth knowledge and applied experience with the Standard Work Specifications (SWS) for GHEP and energy retrofit standards used by WAP Grantees.

  • Demonstrated working knowledge and hands-on experience with WAP-specific energy audit software and tools, including: National Energy Audit Tool (NEAT); Manufactured Home Energy Audit (MHEA); Multifamily Tool for Energy Audits (MulTEA); Energy Audit using the Queens Information Package (EA-QUIP); REM audit software; Targeted Retrofit Analysis Tool (TREAT); Hancock Energy Audit Tool; Energy Conservation Online System (ECOS); and Quick Energy Simulation Tool (eQUEST).
  • Familiarity with key and frequently referenced Weatherization Program Notices, including but not limited to: WPN 19-6 (Annual Historic Preservation Reports); WPN 22-8 (Regional Priority Lists); WPN 23-6 (Revised Energy Audit Approval Procedures); WPN 22-4 (Quality Work Plan / Field Guides); WPN 24-4 (Monitoring Tools/Checklists); and WPN 25-1 (Weatherization Grant Application Information).
  • Experience with, or ability to rapidly become proficient in, DOE systems relevant to WAP grant management and reporting, including Performance and Accountability for Grants in Energy (PAGE) and Infrastructure Exchange.
  • Expertise in federal grants management and fiscal requirements, including 2 CFR 200 and 2 CFR 910.
  • Technical expertise on common energy efficiency systems such as heat pumps, HVAC, building envelope, and other residential retrofits.
  • Experience working with state, local, and tribal governments, with particular emphasis on tribal engagements in both the continental U.S. and Alaska.
  • Demonstrated experience performing data analysis and using analytical tools such as Microsoft 365, PowerBI, Adobe, and other software programs.
  • Capabilities related to briefing and presentation support, document review and evaluation, program evaluation support, document preparation support, and meeting support.
  • Advanced analytical, writing, and oral communication skills with experience presenting information and findings to the Federal Government.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting transition readiness, knowledge transfer, quality assurance planning, system access coordination, and operational readiness reporting for Federal technical, grant, or compliance programs.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Master's degree in engineering, environmental sciences, public administration, or another related discipline.
  • Experience supporting the U.S. Department of Energy, particularly within the Office of State and Community Energy Programs (SCEP).
  • Direct experience managing DOE grants and cooperative agreements, including knowledge of DOE-specific policies, functional requirements, and procedures for SCEP programs (State Energy Program, Weatherization Assistance Program, Energy Efficiency & Conservation Block Grant Program, Home Energy Rebates, Workforce Development, and Energy Codes).
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
  • Field engineering experience with home energy audits and providing technical support for DOE's Home Energy Score.
  • Experience supporting federal programs such as Building America, HUD Healthy Homes, HUD Community Planning and Development, and EPA ENERGY STAR.

LOCATION: This is a remote position in Washington, DC.

SALARY: Salaries are determined based on several factors including external market data, internal equity, and the candidate’s related knowledge, skills, and abilities for the position. The salary range for this position is $100k-125K.

Benefits MELE Offers

About MELE Associates, Inc.

With over 300 employees and offices in Rockville, MD, Washington, DC, and Albuquerque, NM, MELE is a veteran-owned government contractor empowering its customers with innovative solutions for more than three decades. MELE has team members located across the U.S. and has served more than a hundred countries across hundreds of project locations. The company offers technical, engineering, and programmatic support expertise to a host of U.S. federal and international agencies, including, but not limited to, the Department of Energy, the Department of Defense, the Department of Homeland Security, the Department of Justice, INTERPOL, and the International Atomic Energy Agency. MELE’s services include national security, intelligence, IT/cybersecurity, facility management and engineering, CBRNE defense and nuclear security, emergency response training/management, and mission and program support.

We are also excited to announce that Makeship has officially been Great Place to Work-Certified™ for 3 years in a row! Learn more about us at Makeship.com.

During this exciting phase of our growth, you’ll play a huge role in shaping our culture, our process, and the future of Makeship. Every day, you’ll collaborate, learn more about the content creation space, and watch your work impact the company and the community!

We want this to be the best work experience of your life, so we’ll pay you well, offer great benefits, invest deeply in your growth, and welcome you with our branded swag. You will also be joining one of Canada's fastest-growing start-ups!

🌟 What We Are Looking For

We are looking for a hands-on sales leader who blends individual selling with people management, someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment and knows how to build pipelines, close deals, and bring out the best in those around them. As a Sales Manager- Account Executive, you’ll work closely with a team of Account Executives, as well as creators, talent agencies, and industry partners to execute our go-to-market strategy and scale the business.

In this role, you’ll actively manage projects to successful completion from initiation through delivery and closure. This requires excellent coordination of cross-functional teams (through meetings and progress measurement activity) which bring distinct, specific projects to completion both on time and within budget.
